data.title: Bitwise Says Institutions Treat Ethereum, Solana As Venture Bets They Will Sell If Adoption Stalls
data.description: A Bitwise report found Bitcoin is the only cryptocurrency on which significant institutions agree, with Ethereum and Solana considered lesser conditional bets.
data.keywords: ethereum institutional adoption, solana institutional adoption, ethereum price prediction, solana price prediction, institutional crypto adoption, institutional crypto investment, Bitwise institutional crypto report, btc price, sol price, eth price
